title: Network
description: A telecommunication network. A network consists of a set of nodes interconnected by spans.

id.title: UUID
id.description: A universally unique identifier for this network, as defined by [RFC 4122](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc4122). For more information, see the [identifier reference](https://standard.ofds.info/en/{{version}}/reference/identifiers).

identifier.title: Identifier
identifier.description: A local identifier for this network in an internal system.

nodes.title: Nodes
nodes.description: The nodes that belong to this network.

spans.title: Spans
spans.description: The spans that belong to this network.

phases.title: Phases
phases.description: The phases in which this network was, or will be, deployed.

organisations.title: Organisations
organisations.description: The organisations involved in this network.

wayleaves.title: Wayleaves
wayleaves.description: Formal agreements that grant network operators rights to install, maintain or operate telecommunications infrastructure on, over, or under grantors' property or assets.

website.title: Website
website.description: The URL of the website for this network.

publicationDate.title: Publication date
publicationDate.description: The date when this network was published.

collectionDate.title: Collection date
collectionDate.description: The date when the location data was collected. If a dataset was produced by digitising a map, the date that the data for the map was collected.

crs.title: Coordinate reference system
crs.description: The coordinate reference system used in this network. If this network includes any coordinate data (in `Node.location` or `Span.route`) then this field must be provided.

accuracy.title: Accuracy
accuracy.description: The horizontal uncertainty, in metres, of the coordinates in this dataset relative to the datum of the coordinate reference system specified in `crs`. Further details about the accuracy of coordinates in this dataset can be provided in `.accuracyDetails`.

accuracyDetails.title: Accuracy details
accuracyDetails.description: Further details about the accuracy specified in `accuracy`. For example, the confidence level of the accuracy measurement, the methodology used to calculate the accuracy, or a local classification of accuracy.

language.title: Language
language.description: The default language used in text attributes,from the open [language codelist](https://standard.ofds.info/en/{{version}}/reference/codelists#language). A [BCP47 language tag](https://www.w3.org/International/articles/language-tags/) is allowed, if there is a user need for the additional information.

links.title: Links
links.description: Links to related resources. The first item in the links array must be a link to the canonical JSON schema that describes the structure of the data. Links to API endpoints for nodes and spans should be provided when a network is too large to return in a single API response and links to bulk files should be provided when a network is too large to load into memory, for more information, see [how to publish large networks](https://standard.ofds.info/en/{{version}}/guidance/publication#how-to-publish-large-networks).

Node.title: Node
Node.description: A point within a network. A node may be an access point or may reflect a geographic point at which a span splits, aggregates or crosses a border. Nodes can allow for interconnections to other networks or connections to end users.

id.title: Identifier
id.description: A locally-unique identifier for this node.

name.title: Name
name.description: A name for this node. The name should be unique amongst the nodes belonging to a network.

phase.title: Phase
phase.description: The phase to which this node belongs.

status.title: Status
status.description: The status of this node, from the closed [nodeStatus codelist](https://standard.ofds.info/en/{{version}}/reference/codelists#nodestatus).

location.title: Location
location.description: The physical location of this node.

address.title: Address
address.description: The physical address of this node.

type.title: Type
type.description: This node's function, from the open [nodeType codelist]https://standard.ofds.info/en/{{version}}/reference/codelists#nodetype). For nodes with multiple network providers, the union of the node types for each provider. If a node's only function is to serve as a junction between spans, this attribute should be omitted. Junction nodes are identified by the existence of more than two spans that begin or end at the node.

supportingInfrastructure.title: Supporting infrastructure
supportingInfrastructure.description: The infrastructure that supports this node.

type.title: Type
type.description: The type of supporting infrastructure, from the open [nodeSupportingInfrastructure codelist](https://open-fibre-data-standard.readthedocs.io/en/latest/reference/codelists.html#nodesupportinginfrastructure).

description.title: Description
description.description: A description of the supporting infrastructure for this node.

owner.title: Owner
owner.description: The organisation that owns the supporting infrastructure.

spareCapacity.title: Spare capacity
spareCapacity.description: Whether the supporting infrastructure has spare capacity for the installation of additional network equipment.

accessPoint.title: Access point
accessPoint.description: Whether active or passive transmission equipment is installed at this node which is capable of providing access to the network.

internationalConnections.title: International connections
internationalConnections.description: The international connections available at this node. For all connections, `.country` is required.

power.title: Power availability
power.description: Whether power for active network equipment is available at this node.

technologies.title: Technologies
technologies.description: The active technologies used at this node, from the open [nodeTechnologies codelist](https://standard.ofds.info/en/{{version}}/reference/codelists#nodetechnologies). For nodes with multiple network providers, the union of the active technologies used by each provider.

transmissionMediumOwner.title: Transmission medium owner
transmissionMediumOwner.description: The organisation that owns the transmission media for this node, i.e. the passive network equipment such as splitters, combiners and fibre distribution panels.

networkProviders.title: Network providers
networkProviders.description: The organisations that operate the active network infrastructure for this node, i.e. the electrical elements, such as optical transceivers, switches and routers. In open business models, network providers provide wholesale access to service providers such as retail internet service providers. Network providers can own or lease the active network infrastructure.

Span.title: Span
Span.description: A physical connection between two nodes.

id.title: Identifier
id.description: A locally-unique identifier for this span.

name.title: Name
name.description: A name for this span. The name should be unique amongst the spans belonging to a network.

phase.title: Phase
phase.description: The phase to which this span belongs.

status.title: Status
status.description: The status of the network infrastructure for this span, from the closed [spanStatus codelist](https://standard.ofds.info/en/{{version}}/reference/codelists#spanstatus).

readyForServiceDate.title: Ready for service date
readyForServiceDate.description: The date this span was ready to carry traffic. For spans with multiple network providers, the earliest of the dates at which each provider's network was ready to carry traffic on this span.

start.title: Start
start.description: The identifier of one of two nodes that this span connects. If the span is directed, it represents the starting point of the span.

end.title: End
end.description: The identifier of one of two nodes that this span connects. If the span is directed, it represents the end point of the span.

directed.title: Directed
directed.description: Whether this span is directed. If the span is directed, the span begins at the node referenced in `.start` and ends at the node referenced in `.end`. Otherwise, the span connects the nodes referenced in `.start` and `.end` with no direction implied.

route.title: Route
route.description: The physical route that this span takes between the nodes that it connects.

transmissionMediumOwner.title: Owner
transmissionMediumOwner.description: The organisation that owns the transmission media for this span, i.e. the fibre cables.

networkProviders.title: Network providers
networkProviders.description: The organisations that operate the active network infrastructure for this span, i.e. the electrical elements, such as optical transceivers, switches and routers. In open business models, network providers provide wholesale access to service providers such as retail internet service providers. Network providers can own or lease the active network infrastructure.

supplier.title: Supplier
supplier.description: The organisation responsible for installing the cable for this span.

transmissionMedium.title: Transmission medium
transmissionMedium.description: The physical media of this span, from the closed [transmissionMedium codelist](https://standard.ofds.info/en/{{version}}/reference/codelists#transmissionmedium).

deployment.title: Deployment
deployment.description: The physical deployment of this span, from the closed [deployment codelist](https://standard.ofds.info/en/{{version}}/reference/codelists#deployment). Further details of this span's deployment can be provided in `.supportingInfrastructure`.

supportingInfrastructure.title: Supporting infrastructure
supportingInfrastructure.description: The infrastructure that supports this span.

type.title: Type
type.description: The type of supporting infrastructure, from the open [spanSupportingInfrastructure codelist](https://open-fibre-data-standard.readthedocs.io/en/latest/reference/codelists.html#spansupportinginfrastructure).

description.title: Description
description.description: A description of the supporting infrastructure for this span.

owner.title: Owner
owner.description: The organisation that owns the supporting infrastructure.

spareCapacity.title: Spare capacity
spareCapacity.description: Whether the supporting infrastructure has spare capacity for the installation of additional fibre cables.

codeployment.title: Codeployment
codeployment.description: The type of utility or transport infrastrucutre with which this span is codeployed.

cableType.title: Cable type
cableType.description: The type of cable used in this span.

darkFibre.title: Dark fibre availability
darkFibre.description: Whether access to dark fibre is available on this span.

fibreType.title: Fibre type
fibreType.description: The type of fibre used in this span, from the closed [fibreType codelist](https://standard.ofds.info/en/{{version}}/reference/codelists#fibretype). Further details of the span's fibre type can be provided in `.fibreTypeDetails`.

fibreTypeDetails.title: Fibre type details
fibreTypeDetails.description: Further details about this span's fibre type.

fibreSubtype.title: Subtype
fibreSubtype.description: The sub-category of this span's fibre type. For example, G.652.B.

description.title: Description
description.description: A description of this span's fibre type.

fibreCount.title: Fibre count
fibreCount.description: The number of individual optical fibres in this span.

fibreLength.title: Fibre length
fibreLength.description: The physical length in kilometres, of fibre optic cable used in this span.

technologies.title: Technologies
technologies.description: The active technologies used on this span, from the open [spanTechnologies codelist](https://standard.ofds.info/en/{{version}}/reference/codelists#spantechnologies). For spans with multiple network providers, the union of the active technologies used by each provider.

capacity.title: Equipped capacity
capacity.description: The transmission rate, or throughput, of this span, expressed in Gbit/sec (Gbps). The equipped capacity is the total capacity of the circuits (e.g. E1, DS3, STM-1 etc.) which have been activated in the network transmission equipment of the span. For spans with multiple network providers, the sum of the capacity of each provider's network on this span. Further details of this span's capacity can be provided in `.capacityDetails`. For more information, see [equipped capacity](https://standard.ofds.info/en/{{version}}/reference/data_model/#equipped-capacity).

capacityDetails.title: Capacity details
capacityDetails.description: Further details about this span's capacity.

description.title: Description
description.description: A description of this span's capacity.

wayleaves.title: Wayleaves
wayleaves.description: The identifiers of the formal agreements that grant network operators rights to install, maintain or operate this span's infrastructure on, over, or under grantors' property or assets.

countries.title: Countries
countries.description: The countries in which this span is physically located, from the closed [country codelist](https://standard.ofds.info/en/{{version}}/reference/codelists#country).

Phase.title: Phase
Phase.description: A set of nodes and/or spans deployed as a group.

id.title: Identifier
id.description: A locally-unique identifier for this phase.

name.title: Name
name.description: A name for this phase. The name should be unique amongst the phases belonging to a network.

funders.title: Funders
funders.description: The organisations that provide financing for the development or operation of this phase, also known as investors or financers.

id.title: Local identifier
id.description: A locally-unique identifier for this organisation.

name.title: Name
name.description: A name for this organisation. The name should be unique amongst the organisations belonging to a network.

id.title: Identifier
id.description: The identifier assigned to the organisation in the register identified in `.scheme`.

scheme.title: Scheme
scheme.description: The register from which the identifier in `.id` is drawn, from the open [organisationIdentifierScheme codelist](https://standard.ofds.info/en/{{version}}/reference/codelists#organisationidentifierscheme).

legalName.title: Legal name
legalName.description: The legally registered name of the organisation

uri.title: URI
uri.description: A canonical URI for this identifier, such as those provided by Open Corporates. Do not use this field to provide the website of the organisation: instead, use `Organisation.website`.

country.title: Country
country.description: The country in which this organisation is legally registered, from the closed [country codelist](https://standard.ofds.info/en/{{version}}/reference/codelists#country).

roles.title: Roles
roles.description: This organisation's roles in this network, from the open [organisationRole codelist](https://standard.ofds.info/en/{{version}}/reference/codelists#organisationrole). Further details about this organisation's roles can be provided in `.roleDetails`.

roleDetails.title: Role details
roleDetails.description: Further details about this organisation's roles in the network

website.title: Website
website.description: The URL of the website for this organisation.

logo.title: Logo
logo.description: The URL of the logo for this organisation.

Contract.title: Contract
Contract.description: An agreement between the public and private sectors to develop a network.

id.title: Identifier
id.description: A locally-unique identifier for this contract.

type.title: Type
type.description: The type of this contract, from the open [contractType codelist](https://standard.ofds.info/en/{{version}}/reference/codelists#contracttype).

dateSigned.title: Date signed
dateSigned.description: The date this contract was signed.

documents.title: Documents
documents.description: The documents related to this contract.

relatedPhases.title: Related phases
relatedPhases.description: The phases to which this contract relates.

type.title: Type
type.description: The [GeoJSON geometry type](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7946#section-1.4) that is described by `.coordinates`. For a point geometry, the value must be 'Point'.

coordinates.title: Coordinates
coordinates.description: A single [GeoJSON position](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7946#section-3.1.1). A position is an array of numbers with two or more elements.  The first two elements are longitude and latitude, or easting and northing, precisely in that order. Longitude and latitude must be expressed using the World Geodetic System 1984 [WGS 84](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7946#ref-WGS84) datum in units of decimal degrees. Altitude or elevation may be included as an optional third element and must be expressed as the height in meters above or below the WGS 84 reference ellipsoid.

type.title: Type
type.description: The [GeoJSON geometry type](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7946#section-1.4) that is described by `.coordinates`. For a linestring geometry, the value must be 'LineString'.

coordinates.title: Coordinates
coordinates.description: Two or more [GeoJSON positions](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7946#section-3.1.1). A position is an array of numbers with two or more elements.  The first two elements are longitude and latitude, or easting and northing, precisely in that order. Longitude and latitude must be expressed using the World Geodetic System 1984 [WGS 84](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7946#ref-WGS84) datum in units of decimal degrees. Altitude or elevation may be included as an optional third element and must be expressed as the height in meters above or below the WGS 84 reference ellipsoid.

OrganisationReference.title: Organisation reference
OrganisationReference.description: The [local identifier](https://standard.ofds.info/en/latest/reference/identifiers#local-identifiers) and name of the organisation being referenced. Used for cross-referencing within the dataset.

id.title: Local identifier
id.description: The local identifier of the organisation being referenced.

name.title: Name
name.description: The name of the organisation being referenced. This must match the name of the organisation referenced in `.id`.

PhaseReference.title: Phase reference
PhaseReference.description: The identifier and name of the phase being referenced. Used for cross-referencing.

id.title: Identifier
id.description: The identifier of the phase being referenced.

name.title: Name
name.description: The name of the phase being referenced. This must match the name of the phase referenced in `.id`.

streetAddress.title: Street address
streetAddress.description: The street address. For example, 1600 Amphitheatre Pkwy.

locality.title: Locality
locality.description: The locality. For example, Mountain View.

country.title: Country
country.description: The country in which the address is physically located, from the closed [country codelist](https://standard.ofds.info/en/{{version}}/reference/codelists#country).

Document.title: Document
Document.description: A piece of electronic or physical matter that provides information or evidence or that serves as an official record.

description.title: Description
description.description: A description of this document. Descriptions should not exceed 250 words. If the document is not accessible online, the description should describe how to access a copy of the document.

url.title: URL
url.description: A web address for accessing this document.

format.title: Format
format.description: The format of this document, from the open [mediaType codelist](https://standard.ofds.info/en/{{version}}/reference/codelists#mediatype).

CoordinateReferenceSystem.title: Coordinate reference system
CoordinateReferenceSystem.description: The coordinate reference system used in the data.

name.title: Name
name.description: The name of the coordinate reference system.

uri.title: Uniform Resource Identifier
uri.description: A URI for the coordinate reference system.

Link.title: Link
Link.description: A link to a related resource.

href.title: Target
href.description: The URL of this related resource.

rel.title: Relation type
rel.description: The relationship with this related resource, from the open [linkRelationType codelist](https://standard.ofds.info/en/{{version}}/reference/codelists#linkrelationtype). The 'describedby' code must only be used in the first item in the `links` array to link to the schema that describes the structure of the data.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: The currency of this value, from the closed [currency codelist](https://open-fibre-data-standard.readthedocs.io/en/latest/reference/codelists.html#currency).

FibreTypeDetails.title: Fibre type details
FibreTypeDetails.description: Further details about a span's fibre type.

fibreSubtype.title: Fibre subtype
fibreSubtype.description: The sub-category of the fibre type. For example, G.652.B.

description.title: Description
description.description: A description of this span's fibre type.

Wayleave.title: Wayleave
Wayleave.description: A formal agreement that grants a network operator rights to install, maintain or operate telecommunications infrastructure on, over, or under the grantor's property or asset.

id.title: Identifier
id.description: A locally-unique identifier for this wayleave.

grantor.title: Grantor
grantor.description: The entity that grants a network operator the legal right to install, maintain, or operate telecommunications infrastructure on, over, or under property or assets.

yearSigned.title: Year signed
yearSigned.description: The year in which this wayleave was signed.

term.title: Term
term.description: Information about the duration of the wayleave.

indefinite.title: Indefinite
indefinite.description: Whether the term of wayleave is indefinite, i.e. without an end date.

years.title: Years
years.description: If the wayleave's term is definite, its duration in years.

cost.title: Cost
cost.description: Information about the cost of the wayleave.

recurring.title: Recurring
recurring.description: Whether this is a recurring cost.

perMetre.title: Cost per metre
perMetre.description: The average cost per metre for this wayleave. Wayleave costs can include a mix of per length and per item fees, e.g. a fee per metre of cable and a fee per pole. The average cost per metre should be calculated by dividing the total cost of all fees by the total length in metres of cable covered by the wayleave. For recurring fees, the average cost per metre should be annualised.

CapacityDetails.title: Capacity details
CapacityDetails.description: Further details about a span's capacity.

description.title: Description
description.description: A description of this span's capacity.
